title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 Anime's Trailer Unveils January 2027 Debut
content: Aniplex presented a new trailer for Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, during its industry panel at Anime Expo on Thursday. The trailer announces the season's January 2027 premiere.

title: Every Major Netflix Live-Action Anime and Manhwa Adaptation of 2026, Ranked
content: Netflix has emerged as one of the prominent streaming platforms, consistently producing live-action adaptations of anime, manga, manhwa, and many other series. title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 First Trailer and January 2027 Release Date Revealed
content: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 TV anime revealed the first teaser trailer ahead of its January 2027 release date. The anime was first announced as a sequel project , with the format confirmed to be a TV anime at last year’s Jump Festa .

title: The Apothecary Diaries Movie Reveals Key Visual, Trailer, December 11 Premiere
content: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Consort’s Hidden Treasure movie revealed a key visual, trailer, and December 11 premiere date. The movie is set to release in the middle of Season 3, which will air over two parts in Fall 2026 and Spring 2027. Crunchyroll recently confirmed that it will stream the sequel TV anime .

title: The Legend of Aang’s Rumored Release Date Continues an Unfortunate Trend for Avatar: The Last Airbender
content: The Legend of Aang: The Last Airbender has faced a rocky road ahead of its release, and it now looks like it could debut on an earlier date than expected. It’s a turn that would continue an unfortunate trend for the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise. It’s a shame, as its continued popularity demands so much better.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Studio Shares New Look at Original Anime
